ValidationRule.description: Validates that the account Shipping State/Province is a valid two-character abbreviation if Shipping Country is CA.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR(ShippingCountry = "CA"), OR( LEN( ShippingState ) <> 2, NOT( CONTAINS("AB:BC:MB:NB:NL:NT:NS:NU:ON:PC:PE:QC:SK:YT:PQ", ShippingState) )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A valid two-letter province code is required.
